# Crab for the Warden

*Iska is out on a bad tide and will forget to eat, unless there is crab. Bring Dunmor 20 Shore Crab Claws, and tell Iska at the Wardens' House that there is crab on.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Goa Harbour](../towns/goa_harbour_quests.md) |
| Category | Side |
| Given by | [Dunmor](../npcs/dunmor_lamplighter.md) |
| Level | 40 |
| After | [The Sulking Lantern](../quests/dunmor_the_sulking_lantern.md) |

## Objectives

1. Bring 20 [Shore Crab Claw](../items/shore_crab_claw.md) (taken)
2. Talk to [Iska](../npcs/first_warden_iska.md)

## Rewards

- 13,400 EXP
- 1,600 mesos
- [Gap Inn Stew](../items/gap_inn_stew.md) x5
- +30 standing with Goa Harbour
- +200 standing with [Dunmor](../npcs/dunmor_lamplighter.md)
